# Clément Rozé

> Portfolio of Clément Rozé, a designer and developer crafting accessible, intentional, and beautiful web experiences. Includes selected work, in-depth case studies, and a gallery of visual craft.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://clementroze.com/): Overview of Clément Rozé and a curated selection of featured projects.
- [About](https://clementroze.com/about): Background, experience, and the roles Clément has held across internships, freelance work, and collaborations.
- [Work](https://clementroze.com/work): Index of selected projects and case studies spanning product design and development.
- [Craft](https://clementroze.com/craft): A visual gallery of design and interface details, screens, and explorations.

## Case studies

- [frog](https://clementroze.com/work/frog): Designing the next-generation mobile commodity trading platform.
- [General Counsel AI](https://clementroze.com/work/gcai): Building the design foundation for an AI legal platform.
- [Google](https://clementroze.com/work/google): Designing and evaluating user experiences to engage college-age users with Google products.
- [Microsoft](https://clementroze.com/work/microsoft): Copilot-powered B2B sales tools designed for Gen Z buyers.
- [Replit](https://clementroze.com/work/replit): Fostering polish, revamping design systems, and building marketing pages.
